title: Ya aqee abbas ya aqee abbas
body:
bhai tera hota hai khurban -2
ya aqee abbas ya aqee abbas
1. tadapta khaak pe akber ko maine dekha hai
zameen-e- garm pe lashe ko maine dekha hai
sitam ka khaichna,seena se wo sina abbas
<<MINI>>
ya aqee abbas .
<<DIVIDER>>
2. katega sar mera qaime jalaye jayenge
aseer sare jahan mein phiraye jayenge
bhara hai nigaho mein,ab toh bas dhuwa abbas
<<MINI>>
ya aqee abbas . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
3. chala hoon sare masayeb uthake ab ran ko
kahan hain koi jo thame rakabo tausan ko
karunga akhri sajda bhi tanha abbas
<<MINI>>
ya aqee abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
4. nahi hai koi ho seena sipak jo roke waar
giraye ada ne karbal mein ahani deewar
milega ghusl na mujhko kafan yaha abbas
<<MINI>>
ya aqee abbas .
<<DIVIDER>>
5. tujhse tha chain sakina ko sukoon zainab ko
milsakegi na kabhi gham se ama zainab ko
qatl tum kya huwe dil hogaye veera abbas
<<MINI>>
ya aqee abbas . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
6. khauf se tere to dushman ke ude the ausa
door bhage the tujhe dekh ke wo bad emaan
mashk bhar kar raha pyasa tu meri jaan abbas
<<MINI>>
ya aqee abbas . . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
7. haath tere kate dam haton se mera nikla
mashk jab chidh gaye khoon ankhon se tere nikla
tere hanton ka hai islam per ahsan abbas
<<MINI>>
ya aqee abbas . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
8. teer ka mashk pe aana tha ajal ka aana
wo tera suve zameen ghode se niche aana
haye kaise karoon uss karb ka baya abbas
<<MINI>>
ya aqee abbas . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
9. sarwat yeh fizao mein toh zehra ki fugha hai
abbas mera laal mera laal kaha hai
suno yeh aakhri zehra ki hai fughah abbas
<<MINI>>
ya aqee abbas . . . .
